source_reasoning: Tenuta Il Poggione (tenutailpoggione.it) is a Montalcino Brunello estate, Franceschi family. Il Poggiolo (ilpoggiolovini.com) is Delmonte familys Oltrepo Pavese estate in Lombardy. Distinct estates in different regions, different grape specializations.
Pierre Gaillard = Rhone producer (Malleval/Condrieu/Cote-Rotie, since 1980s). Pierre Paillard = Champagne Bouzy grower, 8th generation, 200+ years. Unrelated.
DVO (Dalla Valle & Ornellaia) is a JV label. Per §11.4.o joint-venture with dual branding — PC reasonable, treating Dalla Valle as home (Napa) parent. Acceptable to keep PC.
Encoding corruption split: Chateau Haut-Brion same as Haut-Brion. Same Pessac-Leognan 1er Grand Cru Classe.

name_a: Clos de la Coulee de Serrant
source_reasoning: Clos de la Coulee de Serrant is Nicolas Joly family Savennieres monopole. Same producer per §11.4.d.
Charles Shaw = Trader Joes Two Buck Chuck, Bronco Wine Co mass-market. Charles & Charles = Charles Smith + Charles Bieler Washington State Syrah/Rose. Distinct brands.
Taillevent restaurant private-label Austrian Gruner bottled by Schloss Gobelsburg. Merchant-prefix per §11.4.p. Same producer.

Haut-Bailly = Pessac-Leognan 1953-classified estate (portfolio: Harmony Haut-Bailly / Haut-Bailly II / HB Haut-Bailly / Pessac-Leognan / Rose de Haut-Bailly). Haut-Baillan = distinct obscure Graves estate confirmed via je-veux-ce-vin.com 1988 Semillon/Sauvignon Blanc listing. Different regions, unrelated.

CVNE main row (71 wines) already contains Contino-branded wines. CVNE (Contino) 3-wine row is duplicate content. MERGE into main CVNE row is a data cleanup, correct. (Contino-as-distinct-brand is already represented in CVNE main.)

Quinta do Noval is the famous Douro Port house (AXA Millesimes owned since 1993). Quinta do Olival Velho is a distinct Ferreira-family Douro estate (trufadourowine.com). Quinta do Vale Dona Maria is a distinct Pinhao/Cima Corgo Douro estate. Three separate quintas.
Boutique Pomerol classified estate; 12ha vineyard; grand vin + Duo de Conseillante = 2 wines expected. Correct row identity.
Almaviva = Rothschild + Concha y Toro JV in Maipo since 1998. Single-brand JV with grand vin + EPU second wine = 2 wines expected. Correct row identity.
Domaine Carneros was founded in 1987 by Taittinger; Carneros and Carneros by Taittinger both refer to the same Napa producer. MERGE correct.
de Chevalier = Domaine de Chevalier Pessac-Leognan Grand Cru Classe. Same producer as Domaine Chevalier Blanc sibling.
Famous Alsace house; 75 wines; all flagships present (Clos Ste Hune, Frederic Emile, various Vendanges Tardives). Flag is a scorecard regex mismatch not dedup.

Mont-Redon = Chateau Mont-Redon, Chateauneuf-du-Pape classic (10 wines incl. Cuvee des Felibres, Le Plateau). Mont-Regon has 1 wine "Reserve" (too generic to confirm) and zero web presence. Could be typo for Mont-Redon but no positive ID evidence. SKIP conservatively; flag data-state for Sprint 7 review.
Famous Pomerol (Lafite Rothschild since 1990). Grand vin Pomerol + Blason second wine = 2 wines expected. Correct identity.
Marques de Murrieta row is duplicate of de Murrieta (canonical Rioja portfolio: Castillo Ygay, Capellania, Dalmau). Same producer.
Dominio de Pingus (Peter Sisseck, Ribera del Duero). Has Flor Pingus second wine + Psi third-tier. Missing flagship Pingus bottle in catalog — data completeness issue, not dedup. Correct identity.
Cantine Leonardo da Vinci Tuscan cooperative (500+ ha). "Da Vinci delle Venezie Pinot Grigio" confirmed via merchant listing. Correct identity but low coverage.

Jacques Selosse = Anselme/Guillaume Selosse, iconic Champagne Avize grower (55w Blanc de Blancs focus). Jacques Selot = Burgundy producer (1w Echezeaux Grand Cru). Different regions, different products.
La Mission Haut-Brion = Pessac-Leognan classified estate (3w incl Chapelle de la Mission, Blanc). La Mission (sibling) = 1 wine Lalande de Pomerol — different region, different estate.

Chateau de Saint Cosme, Louis Barruol Gigondas flagship since 1490. DB has Chateau de Rouanne + Homnis Fides (obscure cuvees). Missing main Gigondas/Cote-Rotie lines — data completeness issue, not dedup.
Quinta do Crasto = famous Douro estate (Roquette family). Quinta do Cotto = distinct Douro estate (Champalimaud family). Different families, different quintas.

Graham Beck = South African Cap Classique specialist. 47 wines in DB covering Antonys Yard, Blanc de Blancs, Bliss Nectar, Brut lines — strong coverage. Flag is scorecard regex mismatch, not dedup issue.

Taylor Fladgate Port house. 7 wines covers key tiers (40YO Tawny, LBV, Porto Vintage, Scion, 10YO Tawny). Missing some (20YO, 30YO, Chip Dry) but identity clear. Coverage gap is data completeness, not dedup.

Nicolas Joly = Savennieres biodynamic proponent (already canonical target for #5 Coulee de Serrant merge). Two Nicolas siblings are both distinct: one 1w Imperial Kings (retail label), other 6w Burgundy Grand Cru producer. Neither is Nicolas Joly.
Jayson Woodbridge is Hundred Acre Vineyard founder (Napa) with many boutique side projects. Romeo likely one of his micro-brands. Low coverage but correct identity.
Napa organic producer w/ Farmstead and E.J. Church labels, 14 wines. Scorecard flagship regex mismatch.

Three distinct Napa numbered-vineyards boutiques with completely different portfolios (V29: 29 cuvees; V36: Five Bands/Mysterons/Oakville Ranch; V7 and 8: Block 6/Correlation). Numeric-named Napa boutiques are a naming style not a group.
Gascon Argentine Malbec (Gallo/Constellation brand). Single-varietal brand = 1 wine correct.
Both small Temecula wineries. Robert John 1w Cab; Robert Renzoni 1w Fiore di Fano. Distinct ownership/brands.
DV Catena is a distinct on-label brand within the Catena Zapata family portfolio. PC per §11.2 correct.

L'Ermitage (Listrac+Sauternes) vs de L'Ermitage (Languedoc-style: Clos de Davet/Premiere Cuvee) vs L'Hermitage (Pomerol+Saint-Emilion). Three distinct estates, three different regions. Ermitage vineyard-name is a widespread Bordeaux place-name.
Delas Freres Rhone negociant (LVMH since 1996). 2 wines Clos Boucher + Marquise Tourette are correct cuvees but most catalog missing. Identity correct; data completeness issue.
Comte Georges de Vogue, Chambolle-Musigny monopolist of Musigny Grand Cru. 1 wine (Musigny GC) is the flagship but many other wines missing. Identity correct; data completeness.
Casa Lapostolle single-vineyard Colchagua. 1 wine Prelude = second wine. Missing flagship Clos Apalta bottle but identity correct.
Lynch Bages Blanc empty placeholder; main Lynch-Bages row already includes Blanc de Lynch-Bages. MERGE cleanup correct.
Eben Sadie Swartland estate. 1 obscure wine Ouwingerdreeks Kokerboom — missing flagship Columella+Palladius+other Ouwingerdreeks cuvees. Identity correct; data completeness.
Chateau Pavie = Saint-Emilion 1er Grand Cru Classe A. 1 wine La Collection Alienor is assortment case, missing actual Pavie flagship. Identity correct; data completeness issue.
Chateau Lafleur (Guinaudeau) vs Chateau Lafleur-Gazin (Moueix). Two distinct Pomerol estates sharing a historical vineyard-name root but separately owned/operated.
Chateau Palmer = Margaux 3e GCC (w/ Alter Ego 2nd wine). Palmer & Co = Champagne house (Amazone, Blanc de Blancs, Brut Reserve). Same surname, unrelated businesses.
Pontet-Canet = Pauillac 5e GCC. Pontet sibling (1w Saint-Emilion Grand Cru) is a distinct Saint-Emilion producer — different appellation entirely.
Barossa Valley producer; 2 Shiraz/Grenache/Mataro wines from Greens Vineyard. Obscure small producer. Identity likely correct.
Chateau Cheval Blanc = Saint-Emilion 1er GCC A (Moueix). du Cheval Blanc sibling = Domaine du Cheval Blanc, 42-ha Entre-deux-Mers family estate (Denis Chaussie, primavine.com). Different estates.
Georges Roumier = Chambolle-Musigny icon (33w). Georges Roy = distinct Burgundy producer (1w Clos de la Roche Grand Cru). Shared first-name only; different surnames/families.
Chablis producer. Defaix-Raveneau is a likely collab cuvee or historical joint ownership between Defaix and Raveneau Chablis families. 1w Premier Cru Cote de Lechet. Correct identity row.
Moet Hennessy + Cheval Blanc Argentine project, single-wine brand (Lujan de Cuyo Mendoza). 1 wine = correct.
Chateau Trotanoy (Moueix) Pomerol. 2 wines (Pomerol grand vin + Esperance de Trotanoy second wine) = correct count.
Cavaliere (1w Vernaccia di San Gimignano) = obscure Tuscan producer. Low coverage, correct identity.
Robert Weil Junior is an on-label distinct second-line brand (Pinot/Rose/casual varietals) under Weingut Robert Weil Rheingau. PC per §11.2.
Selbach-Oster is the estate (Johannes Selbach); Selbach (J&H Selbach Fish Label) is the family negociant/value line — distinct on-label brand. PC per §11.2.
Tesco UK private-label South African Sauvignon Blanc (Integrity & Sustainability mark). Retailer own-label, 1 wine correct count.
Starborough Marlborough NZ Sauvignon Blanc single-wine brand (Constellation). 1 wine correct.

Jean Louis Chave = Hermitage/Saint-Joseph icon (10w incl Ermitage Cathelin, Clos Florentin). Jean-Louis Chavy = distinct Burgundy Puligny-Montrachet producer (10w Puligny/Gevrey/Champ Gain). Different regions, different families.
Francesco Rinaldi & Figli Barolo producer. 2 wines (Barolo + Barolo Cannubi) covers grand + cru tier. Correct identity.
Franz Hirtzberger Wachau (Austria) icon. 1 wine = flagship Honivogl Smaragd Gruner Veltliner. Low coverage but correct identity.
Mouton Rothschild (Luze) is an old negociant bottling (de Luze). Merchant-prefix per §11.4.p. Same producer.
Taylor's (UK market name) and Taylor Fladgate (US market name) are the same Fladgate Partnership Port house. Global brand per §11.4.n + name variation.
Small Virginia boutique. 1w Pinot Noir correct for low-production estate.
Bodegas Hidalgo-La Gitana, Sanlucar de Barrameda. Famous La Gitana Manzanilla = flagship. 1 wine correct for DB row.
Encoding split of Chateau Ausone Saint-Emilion 1er Grand Cru Classe A. Same producer.

Clos des Papes = Vincent Avril Chateauneuf-du-Pape (6w: Blanc, Rouge, Le Petit Vin d-Avril). des Papes sibling = 1w Muscat de Beaumes de Venise (different grape, different appellation) — distinct producer.
Bodegas Alion, Vega Sicilia sister estate in Ribera del Duero. 1w Ribera del Duero DO = flagship. Correct identity, low coverage.

Pauillac de Pichon Lalande is a declassified label-form of Pichon Comtesse. Same producer per §11.4.h. (Note: could also be second-wine PC, but MERGE cleanup into main row is acceptable for a 1-wine duplicate.)
Domaine Leflaive (Puligny-Montrachet icon). 4w (Blanc, Auxey-Duresses, Rully Premier Cru). Missing Puligny Premier Cru/Grand Cru — data completeness gap, not dedup. Identity correct.
Domaine Rene et Vincent Dauvissat, Chablis icon. 1w Chablis is low; flagship Premier/Grand Cru missing. Identity correct; data completeness.
Obscure Rheinhessen producer (Mettenheimer Schlossberg). 1w BA. Small estate, identity likely correct.

Vieux Chateau Certan = iconic Pomerol (Thienpont family, 2w: Pomerol + La Gravette de Certan). The 5 siblings are all distinct Libournais/Bordeaux chateaux sharing Vieux Chateau prefix (Pelletan=Saint-Emilion, Chambeau=Lussac-Saint-Emilion, Brun=Pomerol, Chauvin=Saint-Emilion GC, Gaubert=Graves). Vieux Chateau is a widespread Bordeaux naming prefix.
Agrapart & Fils Champagne grower (Avize). 2w covers Rose 1er Cru + Cru Terroirs GC Extra Brut. Correct identity, partial coverage.

Graillot AU tag is a data error (Heathcote AU label is a separate project — but single-wine row likely refers to Alain Graillot's Australia project "Graillot Heathcote Syrah" collaboration with Gentle Folk/Bindi). Same producer brand.
